bullets: Asia/Europe extended the AI-led selloff overnight; SoftBank -15%, S&P and Nasdaq futures down ~0.7%/1.3% on AI-capex doubts.
Geopolitical risk rose after a Houthi attack injured 11 at Saudi PIF's tower; Brent still down ~1.5% on demand concerns.
VIX elevated near 26.4 even as it dips ~1% today; Staples/Discretionary outperform while Semis (-23.5%) and Tech (-17%) lead losses.

RGLD.why: All 22 large gold peers fell with RGLD as gold prices pulled back; no RGLD-specific bad news. Company raised its dividend 10.5% (26th straight year) and guided 2027 mine ramp-up growth.
RGLD.bull: Sector-wide gold pullback hit all 22 large gold peers; RGLD raised its dividend 10.5% and guided 2027 growth.
RGLD.bear: Gold prices remain soft and RGLD trades at a discount to large-cap peers on acquisition-integration concerns.

ELV.bull: Sector-wide MA selloff, but Elevance gains 4-star plan share (40%->53%) and was just upgraded to Buy.
ELV.bear: CMS's $107B bonus-cut proposal creates multi-year earnings uncertainty across the entire MA industry.

HUM.bear: Humana has the most at stake industry-wide, with 4-star membership falling from 25% to 20% next year.
